description: Source code for oseama utility handling Seama seal (container) files, including functions for reading, creating, and extracting entities within the container.

methods.name: oseama_info
methods.description: Displays information about a Seama seal file, including entities and metadata.

methods.name: oseama_entity
methods.description: Creates or appends an entity to a Seama seal file with options for metadata and content.

methods.name: oseama_extract
methods.description: Extracts a specified entity from a Seama seal file to an output file.
